docs: AgentPay Guard — on-chain payment firewall for AI agents.
`lib.rs` only dispatches; logic lives in `instructions/*`.

accounts.name: policy
docs: Seeds use the stored owner (proves a canonical policy PDA);
`has_one = owner` is the authorization check (readable custom error).

accounts.name: merchant
docs: through the `merchant_allowlist` PDA seeds.

accounts.name: merchant_allowlist
docs: `init` (not `init_if_needed`): adding an existing merchant fails (ADR-017).

instructions.name: close_merchant_limit
docs: F-03: remove a merchant's limits (owner only; rent → owner).

instructions.name: close_receipt
docs: F-02: close a receipt after its request can no longer execute; rent → receipt agent.

accounts.name: closer
docs: Policy owner or the agent recorded in the receipt.

instructions.name: close_spending_rules
docs: F-03: remove the rolling limit (owner only; rent → owner).

instructions.name: execute_payment
docs: Arguments order matters: `request_hash` is first because it is used in the receipt seeds.

accounts.name: agent
docs: 1. Only signer with spending rights; also pays the receipt rent.

accounts.name: policy
docs: 2. Canonical policy PDA; authorizes the agent and pins mint/vault.

accounts.name: merchant
docs: Bound by the `merchant_allowlist` PDA seeds + `has_one = merchant`, and by the
merchant ATA check below. Must not be the current agent: `add_merchant` refuses the
agent, but `update_policy(new_agent)` could later make an allowlisted merchant the
agent, which would let the agent pay itself (threat T-29).

accounts.name: merchant_allowlist
docs: 4. Must exist for (policy, merchant). Missing → `AccountNotInitialized`.

accounts.name: spending_rules
docs: agent cannot substitute or omit it); enforced only if it exists, i.e. is owned by this
program. Only this program can make the PDA program-owned, and sending lamports to the
address does not change that, so nobody can turn a rule on or off except the owner.

accounts.name: mint
docs: 5. Classic SPL or Token-2022 mint (F-05); equality via `has_one = mint`. The token
program check sits here so a wrong program fails before the ATA derivations below.

accounts.name: vault
docs: 6. Vault ATA; authority must be the policy PDA.

accounts.name: merchant_token_account
docs: 7. Merchant's ATA for the policy mint (ADR-022: ATA required in MVP).

accounts.name: receipt
docs: 8. Replay protection: `init` fails if this request hash was already executed.

accounts.name: token_program
docs: 9. Token program that owns the mint (classic or Token-2022, F-05).

accounts.name: mint
docs: Classic SPL Token or Token-2022 mint (F-05). Token-2022 extensions are checked in the
handler (`token_policy`).

accounts.name: vault
docs: Vault = ATA(policy PDA, mint, the mint's token program).
`init_if_needed` (ADR-016): ATA creation is permissionless, so a pre-created canonical
ATA must be adopted instead of failing. This is the ONLY use of `init_if_needed`.

accounts.name: token_program
docs: Must be the program that owns the mint.

accounts.name: merchant
docs: and `has_one = merchant`.

accounts.name: merchant_allowlist
docs: A merchant that was never added fails deserialization (`AccountNotInitialized`).

instructions.name: set_merchant_limit
docs: F-03: create or change per-merchant limits for an allowlisted merchant (owner only).

accounts.name: merchant_allowlist
docs: Limits only make sense for an allowlisted merchant (missing → AccountNotInitialized).

instructions.name: set_spending_rules
docs: F-03: create or change the rolling 24-hour limit (owner only).

accounts.name: spending_rules
docs: `init_if_needed`: owner-only and every field is written below (a pre-funded address is
adopted by Anchor's init path, so nobody can block the owner by sending lamports).

accounts.name: mint
docs: Classic SPL or Token-2022 mint; equality via `has_one = mint`.

accounts.name: destination
docs: Any token account of the policy mint whose authority is the owner
(ATA not required). Funds can never be routed to a third party.

errors.name: PolicyPaused
errors.msg: Policy is paused

errors.name: UnauthorizedAgent
errors.msg: Signer is not the policy agent

errors.name: UnauthorizedOwner
errors.msg: Signer is not the policy owner

errors.name: MerchantNotAllowed
errors.msg: Merchant is not allowlisted

errors.name: InvalidMint
errors.msg: Mint does not match policy

errors.name: InvalidVault
errors.msg: Vault does not match policy

errors.name: InvalidMerchantTokenAccount
errors.msg: Merchant token account owner or mint is invalid

errors.name: InvalidAmount
errors.msg: Amount must be greater than zero

errors.name: ExceedsMaxPerTx
errors.msg: Amount exceeds per-transaction limit

errors.name: ExceedsDailyLimit
errors.msg: Amount exceeds remaining daily limit

errors.name: InsufficientVaultBalance
errors.msg: Vault balance is insufficient

errors.name: InvalidRequestHash
errors.msg: Request hash does not match payment fields

errors.name: RequestExpired
errors.msg: Payment request has expired

errors.name: RequestExpiryTooFar
errors.msg: Request expiry exceeds maximum TTL

errors.name: ArithmeticOverflow
errors.msg: Arithmetic overflow

errors.name: InvalidPolicyLimits
errors.msg: Limits must be > 0 and max_per_tx <= daily_limit

errors.name: InvalidAgent
errors.msg: Agent must be non-default and different from owner

errors.name: PolicyAlreadyPaused
errors.msg: Policy is already paused

errors.name: PolicyNotPaused
errors.msg: Policy is not paused

errors.name: InvalidWithdrawDestination
errors.msg: Withdraw destination must be an owner token account of the policy mint

errors.name: EmptyUpdate
errors.msg: update_policy called with no changes

errors.name: InvalidMerchant
errors.msg: Merchant must not be default, the policy, the vault, or the agent

errors.name: UnauthorizedCloser
errors.msg: Only the policy owner or the receipt agent may close a receipt

errors.name: InvalidRentDestination
errors.msg: Rent must be refunded to the agent that paid the receipt

errors.name: ReceiptNotExpired
errors.msg: Receipt cannot be closed before its request expiry plus the grace period

errors.name: UnsupportedMintExtension
errors.msg: Mint uses a Token-2022 extension that is not supported, or is not inert

errors.name: IssuerPowersNotAccepted
errors.msg: Mint has issuer powers (permanent delegate); the owner must accept them explicitly

errors.name: InvalidTokenProgram
errors.msg: Token program does not match the mint's owner program

errors.name: ExceedsRollingLimit
errors.msg: Amount exceeds the rolling 24-hour limit

errors.name: ExceedsMerchantMaxPerTx
errors.msg: Amount exceeds this merchant's per-transaction limit

errors.name: ExceedsMerchantDailyLimit
errors.msg: Amount exceeds this merchant's daily limit

types.name: AgentPolicy
docs: Payment policy and signing authority of the vault ATA (docs/03 §3).
Size: 8 (discriminator) + 202 = 210 bytes.

fields.name: owner
docs: Wallet that created the policy. Immutable.

fields.name: agent
docs: Only key allowed to sign `execute_payment`. Replaceable by the owner.

fields.name: mint
docs: Classic SPL Token mint. Immutable.

fields.name: vault
docs: ATA(owner = policy PDA, mint). Immutable.

fields.name: policy_id
docs: Owner-chosen identifier, part of the PDA seeds. Immutable.

fields.name: max_per_tx
docs: Maximum base units per payment.

fields.name: daily_limit
docs: Maximum base units per UTC day.

fields.name: spent_today
docs: Base units spent during `day_index` (lazily reset).

fields.name: day_index
docs: `unix_timestamp.div_euclid(86_400)` of the day `spent_today` refers to.

fields.name: is_paused
docs: When true, `execute_payment` fails.

types.name: MerchantAllowlist
docs: One allowlist entry per (policy, merchant wallet). Existence means "allowed" (docs/03 §5).
Size: 8 + 74 = 82 bytes.

fields.name: merchant
docs: Merchant wallet (not its token account).

fields.name: is_allowed
docs: Always true while the account exists in the MVP; still checked (defense in depth).

types.name: MerchantLimit
docs: F-03: optional per-merchant limits (docs/16 §2). Exists ⇒ enforced in addition to the
policy limits. Size: 8 + 97 = 105 bytes.

fields.name: spent_today
docs: Base units paid to this merchant during `day_index` (lazily reset).

types.name: MerchantLimitSet
docs: F-03: per-merchant limits created or changed.

types.name: PaymentReceipt
docs: Proof that a canonical payment request executed (docs/03 §6). Closable only via
`close_receipt` after expiry + grace (F-02), when replay already fails with `RequestExpired`.
Size: 8 + 177 = 185 bytes.

types.name: ReceiptClosed
docs: F-02: a receipt was closed and its rent refunded to the agent that paid it.

types.name: SpendingRules
docs: F-03: optional rolling 24-hour limit of a policy (docs/16 §2). Exists ⇒ enforced.
Size: 8 + 241 = 249 bytes.

fields.name: rolling_limit
docs: Max base units in the current hour plus the previous 23 hours.

fields.name: buckets
docs: Spend per UTC hour, ring buffer indexed by `hour.rem_euclid(24)`.

fields.name: current_hour
docs: `unix_timestamp.div_euclid(3600)` of the newest bucket.

types.name: SpendingRulesSet
docs: F-03: rolling limit created or changed (`rolling_limit == 0` never emitted: closing is separate).

constants.name: MAX_REQUEST_TTL_SECONDS
docs: Maximum distance of `expires_at` into the future for a payment request.

constants.name: RECEIPT_CLOSE_GRACE_SECONDS
docs: Extra wait after the latest possible request expiry before a receipt may be closed
(F-02, docs/16 §1): covers cluster clock drift between the close and a replay attempt.

constants.name: REQUEST_HASH_DOMAIN
docs: Domain separator of the canonical request hash (docs/11 §3). 25 bytes.

constants.name: SECONDS_PER_DAY
docs: UTC day length used for the daily spending window.

constants.name: SECONDS_PER_HOUR
docs: Rolling window granularity (F-03): one bucket per UTC hour.

constants.name: SEED_MERCHANT
docs: PDA seed for `MerchantAllowlist`: [SEED_MERCHANT, policy, merchant].

constants.name: SEED_MERCHANT_LIMIT
docs: PDA seed for `MerchantLimit` (F-03): [SEED_MERCHANT_LIMIT, policy, merchant].

constants.name: SEED_POLICY
docs: PDA seed for `AgentPolicy`: [SEED_POLICY, owner, policy_id].

constants.name: SEED_RECEIPT
docs: PDA seed for `PaymentReceipt`: [SEED_RECEIPT, policy, request_hash].

constants.name: SEED_RULES
docs: PDA seed for `SpendingRules` (F-03): [SEED_RULES, policy].
